notes: ABS Data API rows are the latest vintage at retrieved_at. published_at is the calendar release time of each reference period, not a revision timestamp. Back-cast months 2024-04..2025-09 use the 26 November 2025 first publication.
CPI_M (discontinued Monthly CPI Indicator, ABS,CPI_M,1.2.0) was not fetched and must not be used as complete-monthly history.
In-repo July 2026 workbooks and the RBA G1 file are single vintages: every row from those files uses that file's publication time as published_at.

RBA G1 'Publication date' has no clock; published_at is 00:00 Australia/Sydney on that date (clock inferred). Every row in this file shares that vintage date, not the original ABS release of each historical quarter.

In-repo cpi_64010*_jul2026.xlsx files are the July 2026 ABS vintage. They are hashed at their repo path and are not copied. Observations parsed from 640106 use published_at of the 2026-07 reference release for every period, because that is when this vintage's bytes were published (later revisions are inside the file).
640101 and 640106 all-groups index agree on 28 overlapping months
